name: FFQManual
description: On-demand operating and developer manual for Fourier_Quad Pipeline Legacy (F77), including the current initializer/dataset layout, Full/Lite I/O contract, Docker/Apptainer/HPC deployment, parameter tuning, stage behavior, and source changes without hard-binding edits to one checkout.

interface.shortDescription: Legacy Fourier_Quad F77 initializer, pipeline, deployment, and code map
interface.longDescription: A low-context router with on-demand references for the current Legacy F77 initializer and dataset layout, shared Full/Lite product-path contract, compile-time parameters, F6/PSF/shear stages, Docker deployment, direct HPC Slurm generation, full runner-style workflows, and source modification. Reference paths guide navigation while the user's actual source tree remains authoritative.
capabilities: F77 dataset initializer and layout guidance
F77 pipeline architecture and stage routing
Full vs Lite behavior and shared I/O mapping
Docker and full runner-style HPC environment generation
defaultPrompt: Use $FFQManual for this Fourier_Quad F77 pipeline task and load only the references needed for the requested subsystem.
